title: 日本ダービーの後に・たゆたう雷電

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, the hurdle of the Derby proved too high after all. Unable to conquer her fear of racing in a pack, Tamamo Cross loses the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's cry rumbles like thunder through the sky. Her frustration is as clear as day—this isn't who she envisions White Lightning to be, and she won't stand for it.
